body: did you know: midnights had a second surprise the same night. the album dropped at midnight with 13 songs -- then at 3am eastern, seven more just appeared. the great war, paris, high infidelity, dear reader and three others. she called them the "3am tracks," the ones from the journey to find that magic 13.
why: X-native (text-only) version of the Midnights 3am did-you-know, keeping X active. Same sourced facts as the IG sibling, trimmed to the midnight 13-track drop, the 3 a.m. ET reveal of 7 more songs, a few of the titles, and the '3am tracks / magic 13' framing. Every claim traces to the Vault Midnights 'Midnights (3am Edition) surprises fans with 7 more songs' item (Billboard/CBS News). Album-craft lore only, outside every blocklist topic.
